reason: We have to replace lost volume and my team of three only looks after existing accounts, so a pilot with nothing up front, three free meetings and a hard cap of EUR 2,800 is a risk I can put numbers on. One new freight account pays that back many times over, so I would take the free 15-company list and go into the pilot in relationship mode only.
objection: Our name. If messages go out that sound like spam, or a shipper complains about GDPR, that costs me more than any meeting is worth. One client with 45 meetings in 2 months is also only one case, and I don't know how many of those meetings turned into quotes.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 target companies are generic or the first message reads like a template, I stop before the pilot.
